name: Monnbrun
source:
Her true self can be known because of the internet. She is amazed by the internet. She gets lost in it in two seconds.

She is full of things that can't be expressed in real life. She says that she "tends to make herself invisible" but goes on to show rapid progress.

She even does a one-woman comedy show when she shouldn't.

Name Offline: Nagaregawa Kohane
Level: 19 >> 22
Attribute: Light and darkness
Class: Beginner >> Cleric

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/online/character/kohane.htm]official site[/url]]
